Cooked over fire, served with love

Our kitchen

Simple food, done brilliantly

Our menu changes with the seasons and the farmers’ deliveries. Expect smoky grilled meats and fish, vegetables that steal the show and desserts worth saving room for.

  • Local farms and day-boat fish
  • Vegetarian and vegan dishes every day
  • Natural and low-intervention wines

Sunday roasts
